extDescription.message: Adds a pixel-level image diff to the image viewer on GitHub and GitLab — next to 2-up, Swipe and Onion Skin.

showFullFrame.description: Panel button: show the whole frame.

showChangesOnly.description: Panel button: back to the fragment with the changes.

moreControls.description: The «⋯» button: threshold, outline and saving.

popupShowViews.message: Show the before / after / diff switcher

popupLead.message: Adds a Pixel Diff mode next to 2-up, Swipe and Onion Skin — in GitHub's image viewer and in GitLab's.

popupGranted.message: Access granted — the mode will appear in the image viewer.

popupMissing.message: No access: without it the mode won't appear.

popupDenied.message: Access was not granted. You can also enable it in the extension settings, under "Edit websites".

popupNote.message: Access is for viewscreen.githubusercontent.com and gitlab.com. Pages on github.com are never read.

siteTagline.message: Drop two images and see exactly what changed between them.

siteDropHint.message: click, drop or paste an image

siteNeedBoth.message: Add both images — there is nothing to compare yet.

sitePrivacy.message: Nothing leaves your browser. The images are not uploaded anywhere, and there is no server behind this page — it is a static file on GitHub Pages.

siteExtensionPitch.message: Want the same thing inside pull requests?

siteTune.description: Heading of the settings block on the standalone page.

siteColorsHint.message: Red gets lost on a red interface. Here the colour applies at once.

siteLanguageHint.message: This page and the panel. Applies at once — your images stay put.
siteLanguageHint.description: Language hint on the standalone page.

optionsHostBad.message: That does not look like an address. Expected something like gitlab.example.com.

optionsHostCovered.message: This address already works — no need to add it.

optionsUnsupported.message: This browser cannot register content scripts at runtime, so instances of your own are unavailable here.
